steps.title: Identify optimal polymer
steps.instruction: Visit www.polymerscreen.yale.edu, search for your protein in the extraction database, and note the recommended polymer for optimal extraction (e.g., TMEM192 → AASTY650, TGN46 → ChloroSMA60, OMP25 → SMA200, VAPA → AASTY650, KRas → ChloroSMA80).

steps.title: Produce protein source
steps.instruction: Express the protein of interest in cells, or harvest cells for endogenous solubilization.

steps.title: Resuspend membranes
steps.instruction: Resuspend cellular membranes in the chosen polymer and incubate at 4 °C with rotation for 2 hours.

steps.title: Clarify by ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Ultracentrifuge the samples at 200,000 × g for 1 hour to remove insoluble material.
